# Emotion Tracker

A free (GPL-3), offline-first Android app for recording emotions against a
timeline via a tap-driven emotion wheel, targeting F-Droid distribution.
Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Room, single Gradle module, no backend.

## Start Here

- `README.md`: overview, tooling, quickstart.
- `SPEC.md`: the MVP product spec (deleted once the MVP ships).
- `AGENTS.md`: agent operating instructions.
- `DECISIONS.md`: this project's architecture decisions and why.
- `app/src/main/assets/emotion_tree.json`: the emotion wheel's dev-editable content.
- `docs/tooling.md`: pinned dependency versions.
- `docs/development.md`: local development runbook.

## Key Conventions

- No network calls, no `INTERNET` permission, no telemetry — everything is local.
- The emotion tree is referenced by stable per-node id, never by full path.
- No dependency injection framework; one hand-rolled composition root.
- Dependencies must be free software (F-Droid requirement) — see `DECISIONS.md`.

## Validation

```bash
./gradlew check
```
